verdict.rationale: Agent Checkouts document a poll-driven lifecycle where the agent polls the checkout until it reaches a terminal state, and order intents track total, reserved, spent and available amounts. This gives an agent programmatic purchase status, but nothing shows post-purchase fulfillment or shipment tracking for merchant orders. Order-lifecycle webhooks and get-order tracking are documented only for the general Checkout and onramp products, and agent checkouts explicitly have no webhooks in v1. Missing for 10: post-purchase shipment/delivery tracking for agent-placed orders, a documented get-order status endpoint for agent checkouts, webhook notifications for agent orders, independent corroboration.
